items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program for flexible data center power use
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors 計畫，讓資料中心可彈性調降用電
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced the Grid Protectors Program so future compute campuses can reduce electricity demand when the grid is strained, working with utilities, regulators and policymakers. Georgia is the pilot: the Effingham campus agreement includes up to 1,000 MW of flexible demand response (roughly equivalent to 700,000 households) and OpenAI commits to pay full infrastructure costs.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布推出 Grid Protectors 計畫，讓未來算力園區在電網吃緊時可降低用電需求，並與公用事業、監管機構與政策制定者合作。喬治亞州為試點：Effingham 園區協議包含最高 1,000 MW 彈性需求回應（約相當於 70 萬戶家庭），且 OpenAI 承諾支付全部基礎設施成本。
items_flat.analysis_en: The program positions OpenAI as a flexible load that can ease permitting and public pushback on AI power demand by helping utilities manage peaks, while the company still pays its own costs. Effectiveness depends on finalized utility agreements and how quickly flexible campuses come online amid rapid data-center growth.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此計畫將 OpenAI 定位為可協助公用事業管理尖峰的彈性負載，有助減輕 AI 用電帶來的許可與公眾阻力，同時公司仍自行負擔成本。實際成效取決於最終公用事業協議，以及在資料中心快速擴張下彈性園區的上線速度。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re launching the Grid Protectors Program, a national effort to support affordable, reliable electricity for families and businesses in the communities where we build.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Grid Protectors 計畫，這是一項全國性努力，旨在為我們建設所在社區的家庭與企業提供可負擔、可靠的電力。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces LifeVal benchmark for everyday personal-assistant tasks
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 LifeVal 基準，評估 AI 協助日常個人任務能力
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks (finding childcare, managing finances, government paperwork, meal planning, etc.). It is grounded in U.S. and multinational time-use surveys plus a new demographically representative survey of 3,995 respondents; current models score highly on many practical workflows.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布 LifeVal 基準，衡量 AI 協助人們完成日常任務（找托育、管理財務、政府文書、餐點規劃等）的表現。基準以美國與跨國時間使用調查為基礎，並新增 3,995 名人口代表性受訪者調查；目前模型在許多實務工作流程上得分很高。
items_flat.analysis_en: LifeVal shifts evaluation emphasis from academic knowledge toward practical agentic assistance that matches real user demand, reinforcing OpenAI’s push of ChatGPT toward actionable personal agents. It remains an internal evaluation; independent external validation and long-term tracking will determine its influence.
items_flat.analysis_zh: LifeVal 將評估重點從學術知識轉向符合真實使用者需求的實務代理協助，強化 OpenAI 將 ChatGPT 推向可行動個人代理的方向。它目前仍為內部評估；獨立外部驗證與長期追蹤將決定其影響力。
items_flat.quote: To ensure AGI benefits all of humanity, we need to measure and improve model progress on what matters in the lives of everyday people.
items_flat.quote_zh: 為確保 AGI 惠及全人類，我們需要衡量並改進模型在日常人們生活中真正重要事務上的進展。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI raises bug-bounty rewards and prepares next AI-assisted security sprint
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 提高漏洞獎金並準備下一波 AI 輔助安全衝刺
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI more than quadrupled midpoint reward ranges for medium/high/critical findings in its Security Bug Bounty (critical core-product findings now up to $30k base, exceptional up to $172k with bonuses) and added quality, loyalty, and priority-campaign multipliers. It is also planning the next internal security sprint, partnering with Cathedral so external researchers can use OpenAI models alongside internal teams to find and fix weaknesses.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將 Security Bug Bounty 中中等／高／關鍵發現的獎勵中位數提高逾四倍（核心產品關鍵漏洞基礎最高 3 萬美元，卓越發現含獎金最高約 17.2 萬美元），並新增品質、忠誠與優先活動乘數。同時準備下一波內部安全衝刺，與 Cathedral 合作，讓外部研究人員與內部團隊共同使用 OpenAI 模型找出並修復弱點。
items_flat.analysis_en: Higher payouts and continuous AI-driven red-teaming aim to keep the ‘defender’s window’ open as models grow more capable at finding vulnerabilities. The approach depends on sustained external participation and on whether internal sprints can keep pace with model releases.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更高獎金與持續的 AI 驅動紅隊測試，旨在模型找漏洞能力增強時維持「防禦者窗口」。成效取決於外部參與是否持續，以及內部衝刺能否跟上模型發布節奏。
items_flat.quote: We’re more than quadrupling the midpoint of our reward ranges for medium, high, and critical findings on average. A critical vulnerability in a core product such as ChatGPT, Codex, or the API Platform will now earn up to $30,000.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們平均將中等、高與關鍵發現的獎勵範圍中位數提高逾四倍。像 ChatGPT、Codex 或 API 平台等核心產品的關鍵漏洞現在最高可獲 3 萬美元。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 任命 Dan Driscoll 為國家安全現代化資深顧問
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI appointed Dan Driscoll, the 26th U.S. Secretary of the Army, as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization. He will advise senior leadership and external partners on using advanced AI for national and cyber security, with emphasis on working with U.S. allies, building on the company’s Daybreak program.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 任命第 26 任美國陸軍部長 Dan Driscoll 為國家安全現代化資深顧問。他將就如何運用先進 AI 強化國家與網路安全，向資深領導層與外部夥伴提供建議，重點放在與美國盟友合作，並延續公司 Daybreak 計畫。
items_flat.analysis_en: The hire signals OpenAI’s continued push into government and allied national-security use cases beyond pure commercial products. Impact will depend on how quickly practical modernization initiatives materialize and on the evolving policy environment for dual-use AI.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此任命顯示 OpenAI 持續將觸角延伸至政府與盟友的國家安全應用，超越純商業產品。實際影響取決於實務現代化倡議的落地速度，以及雙用途 AI 政策環境的演變。
items_flat.quote: Dan Driscoll will join OpenAI as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization, working with senior leadership and external partners to advise on how advanced AI can strengthen national and cyber security.
items_flat.quote_zh: Dan Driscoll 將加入 OpenAI 擔任國家安全現代化資深顧問，與資深領導層及外部夥伴合作，就先進 AI 如何強化國家與網路安全提供建議。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches message threads beta to cut latency for long-running agents
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出訊息執行緒公開測試，降低長時間代理延遲
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic made message threads available in public beta on the Claude Platform (and partner clouds). Agents send the full conversation only on the first turn; subsequent turns transmit only new messages plus the previous response ID. Threads are in-memory, encrypted, and expire after inactivity; Anthropic reports ~35% lower median time-to-first-token on 500k–1M token requests for most Claude Code users. Pricing and rate limits unchanged.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 Claude Platform（及合作雲端）公開測試推出訊息執行緒。代理僅在第一輪傳送完整對話，後續輪次只傳送新訊息加上前一回應 ID。執行緒存於記憶體、加密，且閒置後過期；Anthropic 表示對大多數 Claude Code 使用者，在 50 萬至 100 萬 token 請求上中位首次 token 時間降低約 35%。定價與速率限制不變。
items_flat.analysis_en: The feature directly attacks the latency tax of long agent sessions without changing pricing or context windows, making high-volume coding and computer-use agents more practical. Developers still must manage their own conversation copies because threads expire quickly and are ineligible for zero-data-retention or HIPAA setups.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此功能直接降低長時間代理會話的延遲成本，而不改變定價或上下文窗口，讓高用量編碼與電腦使用代理更實用。開發者仍須自行保存對話副本，因為執行緒很快過期，且不適用零資料保留或 HIPAA 設定。
items_flat.quote: New in the Messages API, send your conversation once, and the API receives only what’s new with every turn.
items_flat.quote_zh: Messages API 新功能：只需傳送一次完整對話，之後每一輪 API 只接收新增內容。

items_flat.title_en: SpaceXSI details internal Data Bot Team Bot that scaled data-science help
items_flat.title_zh: SpaceXSI 詳述內部 Data Bot Team Bot，擴大資料科學協助
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXSI published a case study of Data Bot, a Team Bot in Grok Bot taught by the internal data-science team. It can query the warehouse, run analyses, create charts/dashboards, and join Slack channels using shared skills and memory. Last week it handled an estimated 70 hours of work that would otherwise have gone to the data team; complex judgment-heavy analyses remain with humans.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXSI 發布 Data Bot 案例研究，這是由內部資料科學團隊教導的 Grok Bot Team Bot。它可查詢資料倉儲、執行分析、建立圖表／儀表板，並使用共享技能與記憶加入 Slack 頻道。上週估計處理了原本會落到資料團隊的約 70 小時工作；需高度判斷的複雜分析仍由人類負責。
items_flat.analysis_en: The internal success story shows Grok Bot Team Bots moving from generic agents to role-specific shared expertise, potentially reducing specialist bottlenecks. External customers still lack equivalent shared organizational memory and governance features at the same scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此內部成功案例顯示 Grok Bot Team Bots 正從通用代理轉向角色專屬的共享專業知識，可能減少專家瓶頸。外部客戶目前仍缺乏同等規模的共享組織記憶與治理功能。
items_flat.quote: Data Bot is a Team Bot in Grok Bot that the data science team teaches, so every team can query the warehouse, run analyses, and get answers the way a data scientist would.
items_flat.quote_zh: Data Bot 是 Grok Bot 中的 Team Bot，由資料科學團隊教導，讓每個團隊都能查詢資料倉儲、執行分析，並以資料科學家的方式取得答案。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens applications for paid AI safety Residency program
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 開放付費 AI 安全 Residency 計畫申請
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced that applications are open for the Anthropic Residency, a paid fixed-term research program for academics, technical founders, and staff-level engineers who want to work on making AI safe and beneficial. No machine-learning background is required. Placements last six weeks to six months with annualized compensation of $350k–$500k; applications close November 22, 2026.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布開放 Anthropic Residency 申請，這是面向學者、技術創辦人與資深工程師的付費固定期限研究計畫，目標是讓 AI 更安全且有益。不需機器學習背景。駐留期為六週至六個月，年化薪酬 35 萬至 50 萬美元；申請於 2026 年 11 月 22 日截止。
items_flat.analysis_en: The residency lowers the barrier for non-ML experts to contribute to frontier safety work, potentially broadening the talent pool amid intense hiring competition. Details on cohort size, selection criteria, and conversion rates to full-time roles remain limited until the first round concludes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此駐留計畫降低非 ML 專家參與前沿安全工作的門檻，可能在激烈人才競爭中擴大人才池。第一輪結束前，關於 cohort 規模、甄選標準與轉正率的細節仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Applications are now open for the Anthropic Residency, a paid, fixed-term research program for academics, technical founders, and staff-level engineers who want to make AI safe and beneficial for everyone. No ML background is required.
items_flat.quote_zh: Anthropic Residency 現正開放申請，這是面向學者、技術創辦人與資深工程師的付費固定期限研究計畫，目標是讓 AI 對所有人更安全且有益。不需機器學習背景。

Details on cohort size, selection criteria, and conversion rates to full-time roles remain limited until the first round concludes.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此駐留計畫降低非 ML 專家參與前沿安全工作的門檻，可能在激烈人才競爭中擴大人才池。第一輪結束前，關於 cohort 規模、甄選標準與轉正率的細節仍有限。
anthropic.quote: Applications are now open for the Anthropic Residency, a paid, fixed-term research program for academics, technical founders, and staff-level engineers who want to make AI safe and beneficial for everyone. No ML background is required.
anthropic.quote_zh: Anthropic Residency 現正開放申請，這是面向學者、技術創辦人與資深工程師的付費固定期限研究計畫，目標是讓 AI 對所有人更安全且有益。不需機器學習背景。

xai.title_en: SpaceXSI details internal Data Bot Team Bot that scaled data-science help
xai.title_zh: SpaceXSI 詳述內部 Data Bot Team Bot，擴大資料科學協助
xai.summary_en: SpaceXSI published a case study of Data Bot, a Team Bot in Grok Bot taught by the internal data-science team. It can query the warehouse, run analyses, create charts/dashboards, and join Slack channels using shared skills and memory. Last week it handled an estimated 70 hours of work that would otherwise have gone to the data team; complex judgment-heavy analyses remain with humans.
xai.summary_zh: SpaceXSI 發布 Data Bot 案例研究，這是由內部資料科學團隊教導的 Grok Bot Team Bot。它可查詢資料倉儲、執行分析、建立圖表／儀表板，並使用共享技能與記憶加入 Slack 頻道。上週估計處理了原本會落到資料團隊的約 70 小時工作；需高度判斷的複雜分析仍由人類負責。
xai.analysis_en: The internal success story shows Grok Bot Team Bots moving from generic agents to role-specific shared expertise, potentially reducing specialist bottlenecks. External customers still lack equivalent shared organizational memory and governance features at the same scale.
xai.analysis_zh: 此內部成功案例顯示 Grok Bot Team Bots 正從通用代理轉向角色專屬的共享專業知識，可能減少專家瓶頸。外部客戶目前仍缺乏同等規模的共享組織記憶與治理功能。
xai.quote: Data Bot is a Team Bot in Grok Bot that the data science team teaches, so every team can query the warehouse, run analyses, and get answers the way a data scientist would.
xai.quote_zh: Data Bot 是 Grok Bot 中的 Team Bot，由資料科學團隊教導，讓每個團隊都能查詢資料倉儲、執行分析，並以資料科學家的方式取得答案。

brief_en: On Nov 2 OpenAI launched Grid Protectors for flexible data-center power, published the LifeVal everyday-task benchmark, raised bug-bounty rewards (critical findings up to $172k with bonuses), prepared a new AI-assisted security sprint with partner Cathedral, and appointed former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization. Anthropic opened message-threads beta to cut long-agent latency ~35% and applications for its paid Residency. SpaceXSI detailed its internal Data Bot Team Bot that handled ~70 hours of data-science work last week.
brief_zh: 11月2日OpenAI推出Grid Protectors計畫讓資料中心可彈性降電，發布LifeVal日常任務基準，大幅提高漏洞獎金（關鍵漏洞最高約17.2萬美元含獎金），準備與Cathedral合作的下一波AI安全衝刺，並任命前陸軍部長Dan Driscoll為國家安全現代化資深顧問。Anthropic開放訊息執行緒公開測試以降低長時間代理延遲約35%，並開放付費Residency申請。SpaceXSI詳述內部Data Bot Team Bot，上週處理約70小時資料科學工作。
